claims.description: Adding, removing, or editing style elements invalidates cached layout snapshots.

notes.text: Package-contract tests verify snapshot invalidation when `style` elements are added, removed, or edited.

claims.description: Inserting, changing, or deleting CSSOM rules invalidates cached layout snapshots.

notes.text: The engine tracks per-sheet CSSOM revisions through mutation methods and declaration setters because CSSOM edits do not emit `MutationObserver` records. Cached reads compare sheet identity, revision, rule count, authored text, and disabled state without serializing unchanged rules; non-patchable or inaccessible CSSOM falls back to content fingerprinting.
